description: Create a job. Required: status, title, description, location_country; location_city unless is_remote is true.

ai_scoring_criteria.description: AI scoring criteria for ranking applicants

id.description: Existing criterion id; omit to create

form_id.description: Omitted = new form named after the job

is_hybrid.description: Hybrid job: office days plus remote days; keeps the address and needs is_remote false. Indeed lists it as Hybrid Remote, LinkedIn as Hybrid

is_remote.description: Remote job; with empty city, state and postal code Indeed posts it nationwide

job_board_remote_scope.description: Indeed-only remote scope; other boards keep the address. Non-city needs is_remote true; statewide needs location_state; null resets to city.

knockout_questions.description: Yes/No screening questions added to the application form

language.description: Job page locale, e.g. de-DE; null = follow the career site language. Values: hires_list_languages

location_city.description: Required unless is_remote; empty = nationwide remote posting on Indeed. An unrecognised place is saved but flagged on the job boards tab

location_country.description: Country name or ISO alpha-2 code from the country list; others are rejected

location_full_address.description: Ignored; the address is built from the other location fields

parent_job_id.description: Parent job; makes this a satellite job

workflow_id.description: Omitted = new workflow named after the job

name: hires_create_job
